sourceText: User required that any Proofbound CLI code changes must go through the Proofbound Story process, then asked to finish the Prodenovo Ranking B-35f0 lifecycle. B-35f0 was blocked because Lattice REVIEW-to-TEST gates scanned unrelated metadata-root dirty files instead of the clean story worktree.
normalizedOutcome: Proofbound CLI gates inspect the authoritative story worktree for story-owned code/lint/scope checks, so B-35f0 can advance without touching unrelated Prodenovo main-workspace dirty files.
acceptanceClaim: A clean story worktree is no longer blocked by unrelated dirty or untracked files in its metadata root during REVIEW-to-TEST gate preflight.
